english: Yes. I saw him leave Dokoka Town.
I never thought he'd leave.\nI couldn't make it in time.
Maybe I went too far saying\nhe has no presence...?
The no-presence thing is true, nyo.
He ran because he's scared of me...?
If that's how it is,\ngood riddance, nyu!
Puchiko's right.\nIf he's that hopeless,\ngood riddance!
That's right. [MERU],\nyou've got nothing to feel bad about.
That's right. [NOEL],\nyou've got nothing to feel bad about.
But... could there be another reason...?
But I can't think of any other reason...?
That idiot! I'll catch him for sure!
Don't talk about him like he's a criminal...
No! Disappearing right when we all\novercame something together —\nthat's unforgivable!
Leaving without a word is unacceptable.
I'd like to strike him down myself, but...
Would someone that thoughtless\nreally have stuck with us this long?\nThis wasn't his first chance to run.
I think so too.\n[CLAUDE] was always so earnest.
When we first met,\nhe tried to be a decoy to break through\nthe Noise's encirclement. Unarmed, even so.
That's why I can't forgive him\nfor vanishing without a word!
Of course. Someone who skips club on their own\nneeds to be made an example of\nwith plenty of punishment.
Everyone, think about\nwhat outfit to put him in~.
He'd better be ready\nfor at least body paint, nyo!
Ehehe... how about\nsomething fluffy,\nlike a kitty costume!
Blond mode with an orange gi, nyu.
Ta-daa! We've been waiting for you!
Nothing to be surprised about.\nDo you two know who I am?
Sorry, but could you take me\nto your mother?
Maybe you'll understand if I put it this way.\nThis is your Mama's will.
Come to think of it, Eve said\nPolyal has a will.\nI wonder what that means.
I wonder if he went to Eve's lab?
There was no sign the teacher\nresearched [CLAUDE], though.
Before searching for [CLAUDE],\nit seems there's something to do.
How'd they find out our movements!?
You were a pain when you were the enemy too, nyu.
This is the rest... *cough cough*,\nmy secret stash!\nEnjoy! Byebye!
(Leftovers, she says...?\nMaybe I should give her a nice shock.)
Black... me... I want to fight.
You're Nacchan? Don't make me laugh~!\nThe real one's way cuter!
This really is unpleasant...\nAm I like this~?
Maybe if I add more hair ties?\nFufu.
Riko's a master of disguise,\nand that doesn't look like me at all!\nDo over! And it's not cute!
That's dealt with for now, but\nMie was here a moment ago, right?
What bugs me is why\nMie summoned the black Teslas.
Weren't they something\nMie and Kei created?
But that doesn't explain why\nthe black me knew about\nGandalfr.
The black me felt like she'd known\nsome great despair and changed.
If they were made as pawns from the start,\nthey shouldn't know sadness...
The super Soniko had a heart too...\nShe looked like she was fighting\nfor some purpose.
Doesn't look like we'll get answers yet.
That bugs me too, but\nlet's look for [CLAUDE] now!
[CLAUDE]'s on foot.\nHe can't have gone farther than\nthe IS can cover, but...
Just because he has no presence,\nhe doesn't have to vanish this completely!
Can't help it if he's a ninja.
It's getting dark. Let's search\nagain tomorrow.
That's right!\nYou can't find someone\nif you give up after just one day!
Tonight, let's all\nthink about places\n[CLAUDE] might go.
I do... probably better than you two...
Unable to comprehend. We were not\ninformed of your existence.
Figured.\nYou two were born\nlong after me...
